decision.reason: No hybrid fixed or adaptive arm passed the strict keep-versus-move economic gate on either development asset in base or stress, full-session or off-hours mode.

interpretation.AAPL: The pre-existing inventory-only development arm had positive modeled pool-marked results; the staged hybrid did not enter.
interpretation.NVDA: The pre-existing controls lost absolute value in the development window; the staged hybrid did not enter.
interpretation.cashAlpha: When a hybrid never enters, pool-marked alpha is zero. The inherited alphaQuote subtracts passive liquidation costs and is not used for selection.

dayLevelDispersion.reason: The retained full replay did not persist independent-reference interval marks; no day-level alpha is manufactured from terminal pool marks.
